limitations: Specialized platform benchmark; preserved in its original format, not a training recipe.
summary:
# Local PyTorch CPU / Metal benchmark

Measured on 2026-09-08: Apple M5 Pro, 18 CPU cores, 20 GPU cores, 64 GiB unified memory; PyTorch 2.10.0.

Median optimization seconds over three warm trials, each 200 full-batch Adam updates. Same initial weights, float32, actual policy architecture, masked cross-entropy and per-step finite-loss check. Device configurations run sequentially in shuffled order.

| Batch | Backend | CPU threads | Median seconds | Min-max seconds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 96 | cpu | 1 | 0.529 | 0.514-0.557 |
| 96 | cpu | 4 | 0.302 | 0.300-0.307 |
| 96 | cpu | 6 | 0.320 | 0.318-0.324 |
| 96 | mps | 1 | 0.184 | 0.170-0.189 |
| 768 | cpu | 1 | 3.864 | 3.849-3.880 |
| 768 | cpu | 4 | 1.786 | 1.778-1.790 |
| 768 | cpu | 6 | 1.639 | 1.631-1.653 |
| 768 | mps | 1 | 0.600 | 0.600-0.607 |

The 96-position batch uses actual saved training examples. The 768-position batch repeats them eight times to measure workload scaling; it is not new data or generalization evidence.

MPS timing synchronizes GPU work at measurement boundaries. CPU fallback is not enabled. All 24 trials completed with finite losses, 100% training agreement, and identical training-set predictions after moving final weights to CPU. This does not establish cross-device bitwise equivalence or checkpoint serialization behavior.

These are warm optimization timings, excluding Python startup, teacher labeling, replay/tensor preparation, validation and disk IO. First MPS 10-step warmup plus setup/checks took 1.480 seconds; cold one-off jobs may not benefit. Trials ran on the active desktop without controlling other load or thermal state.

Recommendation: retain CPU as the portable default test lane; use explicit MPS for repeated local training, with an optional MPS smoke lane. Four CPU threads are a reasonable fallback for this small model. No production defaults, weights, or dependencies were changed.

Reproduce from the repository root with GPU access:

```sh
.venv/bin/python artifacts/learning/device-benchmark/benchmark.py
```

Raw trials: results.json. Exact script SHA-256: bdfa13a0dbcb9ec2a98e21f5c327b3c315eb21c445673474849b4e37f548d51e.
